responsibility: Declares the abstract base class for Rust HIR types. `Type` provides the common node interface for all lowered type forms, including cloning, stringification, source location and `Analysis::NodeMapping` storage, visitor dispatch, and a virtual `to_trait_bound` hook used by types that can also appear as trait-bound syntax. This is the root contract that concrete HIR type classes in `rust-hir-type.h` build on.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract root `Type` interface for HIR types, with common node API, mapping/location storage, cloning, visitors, and the virtual `to_trait_bound` hook that concrete types may override. Unlike `rust-hir-type-abstract.cc`, it establishes the base contract rather than just the default null `to_trait_bound` implementation.
